claim: Clay Pit workers start their shift a tenth of a day later than the standard workplace shift and finish a tenth of a day later; the shift is the same length (60% of the day).

evidence.reference: WorkplaceConfig.WorkTimeRange. Clay Pit stores 0 → 0.6; 53 workplaces including Farm and Bakery store the standard 0.9 → 0.5 (wrapping past 1.0). Foresters' Hub, Orchard and Quarry store 0 → 0.5 (same late start, standard finish); Cheesery, Chicken Coop, Fondue Bar and Roadworks Office store 0.95 → 0.55.

notes: Community reports that clay workers are late risers match the stored schedule. The research agent traced the clock code (26 Oct 2026): the dial shows its day face for cycle fractions up to 0.5 and its night face after, and the shift range is compared directly with that fraction, so the standard crew starts a tenth of a day before the day face and stops at the night face, while the Clay Pit starts at the day face and works a tenth of a day into the night. The game displays no numbered hours. Whether the crew also sleeps longer is tracked in clay-pit-late-start.
